messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: @lee (oncall-sre) — Policy evaluation errors increasing across routing service. 5xx spikes and observed region fallback loop. Affected: hosted API (us-west primarily). Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/policy-engine

lee: ack'd — I'm on it. seeing ~12% 5xx for text/generate routes, latency +200-400ms. adding @jordan and @nina.

jordan: digging in logs — there's a deploy of policy-bundle v2026-03-15T02:10 (commit d4c3f7) ~6m ago. errors start ~02:12.

lee: paste of error snippet:```
2026-03-15T02:12:23Z policy-eval error: panic: unknown operator 'matches' in expression
stack: github.com/redwood/policyengine/eval.go:412 -> evalExpr
caused by: invalid AST node: MatchExpr
```

nina: customer-impact? which customers / SLAs hit?

lee: preliminary: mostly hosted customers in us-west endpoints, approx 11-14% of requests failing rather than routing to variants. A few premium customers reported degraded responses. No data loss.

alex: support: starting triage banner for affected tenants, preparing targeted messages for premium accounts.

jordan: the rule that landed has a `matches` operator that isn't supported by the runtime (we don't allow regex ops in expressions). suspect eval path throws instead of gracefully erroring.

jordan: propose immediate mitigation: disable the failing policy rule or set routing to safe-default. I can run disable if we want fast rollback.

lee: please run the disable. post command and output. I'll coordinate incident channel and customer comms.

jordan: running:```bash
redwoodctl policies disable --bundle policy-bundle:v2026-03-15T02:10 --rule route_preferred_region
```

ops-bot: executing: redwoodctl (cluster: hosted) — FYI this will apply a hotfix and may cause brief config reload.

jordan: done — CLI output:
```
Disabled rule route_preferred_region in policy-bundle:v2026-03-15T02:18
Applied to 4 routing nodes.
Rolling config reload initiated.
```

incident-bot: Observability update: error-rate for policy-eval (route-engine) dropped from 12.3% -> 0.9% in 3m after change. Latency back to baseline.

nina: confirmed: traffic is now hitting safe-default routing variant. Some customers served older model variant (slower) for short window but no client errors.

jordan: captured problematic snippet from the bundle that triggered engine crash:```yaml
rule: route_preferred_region
when: request.model_variant == "redwood-v2-ggml" and request.region matches "^us-"
action: route(region: "us-west-2", model: "redwood-v2")
```
This `matches` token ended up as a MatchExpr which our evaluator doesn't handle and causes a panic path. Should've been `regex_match(request.region, "^us-")` or precompiled label.

lee: handoff: I need to go offline for 30m. @jordan please take incident ownership for postmortem and follow-ups. I'll update pager duty.

jordan: taking it. next steps: 1) rollback offending bundle (done), 2) add lint + CI guard to reject unsupported operators, 3) change runtime to return eval errors instead of panics, 4) add dashboard alert for policy-eval panics. I'll file issues and assign.

alex: support message drafted to affected customers and premium accounts; will follow up when we have root-cause written.

ops-bot: chart snapshot: policy-eval panics (count) -> spike to 84 at 02:12, then down to 2 after 02:18.

nina: quick ask: did any requests reach third-party partner connectors during loop? need to check for duplicate side-effects.

jordan: initial trace: most failed early, didn't reach connectors. We'll run a focused trace job for high-risk tenants.

lee: thanks team. we'll run a follow-up postmortem. Action owners: jordan (root cause + runtime fix), nina (customer impact verification), alex (customer comms), lee (incident review). Closing active page for now. :white_check_mark:
